description: Rules and current funding for one perpetual futures contract on one exchange: mark price, size step, minimum size, price tick, maximum leverage, funding rate per interval and annualised. Use when a limit price or leverage must fit the venue; not needed for market orders (sizing and preview round for you). Not for comparing exchanges (use compare_perp_quotes_across_venues or compare_funding_rates_across_venues). Inputs: symbol (base coin, e.g. BTC), venue (without an account: hyperliquid only). Prices in USD per coin, sizes in the base coin, rates as fractions. Next: size_position_by_risk.

venue.description: Venue: sandbox, hyperliquid, okx, bybit or binance. Omitted: the agent's only venue, else hyperliquid, else your only connected venue, else sandbox
